name: file-icons
title: File Icons
description: A collection of monochrome icons for file types, languages and developer tools, with a helper that picks the right glyph from a file extension. The demo shows them in a labelled grid and a small source tree.
use: A file tree, editor tab bar or docs list needs a matching glyph for each file type.
avoid: You need colourful brand logos or types beyond the included extensions; others fall back to a generic file.
a11y: Icons are decorative and marked aria-hidden in the demo, and the SVGs carry no titles of their own. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A grid of dark bordered tiles, each holding a white monochrome glyph and a small grey label. Below it a bordered panel lists src files under a folder heading, each row with a tiny icon and a monospace filename.
behaves: The glyphs themselves are static; hovering a tile or a file row tints its background grey. A helper swaps the icon according to the supplied file extension.
customise: Pick an icon by key or call the extension helper; colour follows currentColor and classes. Adding a new file type means editing the source.
weight: light: Inline SVG paths with CSS-only hover colours; no animation or runtime loop.
demo: Labels like logo, twitter, react, tailwind, json, ts, css; files package.json, globals.css, button.tsx, utils.ts.
issues: Only json, css and js/ts family extensions map to icons; everything else gets a generic file glyph.
The file rows are static list items, not real links or selectable files.
polishWhy: A wide, consistent monochrome set with tidy labels and a clear file-tree example.
